page.layout: One printed page, one column of running text. No marginal notes. Bleed from the neighbouring page shows at the left edge and at the bottom left, and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: ambobus. Qua ratione fiebat, ut Lacones, cum in viros adolevissent, ante alios omnes hoc genere plurimum valerent, propriumque eorum censeretur, argute interrogare, & ex tempore concinnè & breviter respondere: Unde illa tot numero tam insignia Laconum apophthegmata à Plutarcho recitata. Huic vero cognatum id quoque erat, quòd à pueris usque iidem ex instituto Lycurgi assuefierent sermone uti non nisi graui, de rebus honestis, cui ad virtutis studium aliquis inesset stimulus: cujus forma postea in adultis quoque remanebat. Adspergebantur autem sermoni huic ut plurimum etiam joci, ut essent laborum & victus asperioris quoddam cum condimento levamen.

Sed enim in corripiendi ratione eveniebat non raro, ut Iren, qui turmae alicui praerat, praesentibus viris primariis indelinquentes animadverteret, eoque do-[?]lmentum ederet, rectène an secus, quod debebat, noïlet facere, nec quisquam eum hoc agentem turbaret: verum dimisso jam turmalium coetu, si vel asperius vel levius quàm par esset videretur animadvertisse, tunc ipse viris poenas ut daret. page.notes: Doubtful readings: "do-[?]lmentum" (the word is partly covered by bleed from the left edge; "documentum" is likely but not legible). "rectène" and "noïlet" as printed, with the spelling in the scan. Long s is shown as plain s throughout. Left-edge fragments ("m", "ebau", "gp", "re") and the bottom-left marks are bleed from the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. No catchword is visible at the foot.
